body.value:
1. صح ذلك عندي وكتب
  2. الحسن بن ابراهيم وكتب بخطه
  3. بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
  4. هذا ما اشتری بندلوس بن بطرس الخياط من بقام بن كيل بن قوريل و هما جميعا من سكان الضيعة المعروفة بططون من بعض قري كورة
  5. الفيوم اشترى منه المجلس المعروف بمجلس أبو ثيدر بحده و حدوده و علوه و سفله و خشبه [و أبوابه] و حجارته و هو معروف مشهود
  6. لكيل بن قوريل و شهرته تغني عن تحديده و المجاز التي من باب المنزل الکبير الی ان يطلع الی هذا المجلس المذكور و الخزانة التي
  7. تحت هذا المجلس بحدها و حدودها و كل حق هو لها داخل فيها و خارج منها و ابوابها و خشبها وحجارتها و يشرع بابها الي المنزل الكبير
  8. المعروف بمنزل كيل بن قوريل اشترى جميع ذلك المجلس و مجازه و الخزانة و مجازها بمال مبلغه من العين المعزي الوازن
  9. تسعة دنانير نصفها اربعة دنانير و نصف عينا ذهبا جياد العيون قد قبض بقام بن كيل بن قوريل من بندلوس
  10. بن بطرس الخياط هذا الثمن تاما وافيا و أبراه من ذلك براة قبض و استيفا و سلم اليه هذا الملك المذكور
  11. الموصوف و ملكه و حازه و صار مالا من ماله و ملكا من ملكه ان شا باع و ان شا وهب و ان شا حبس
  12. بيع صحيح لا شرط فيه و لا خيار و لا استثنا و لا مثنوية و متا ما ادرك بندلوس بن بطرس في هذا الشر ي
  13. من درك او علقة او خصومة او طاري بدين او مستحق بميراث فخلاص ذلك و نفاذه علي بقام بن كيل من خالص
  14. ماله كاين ما كان و بالغ ما بلغ و ذلك بعد أن قرئ عليها جميع ما في هذا الكتاب حرفا حرفا فاقرا
  15. بفهمه و معرفته و ذلك و في صحة من عقلهما و ابدانهما و جواز امورهم طائعين غير مكرهين ولا مجبرين ولا مظطهدين وكتب
  16. في شهر صفر سنة ثلثين و اربع ماية

1. The validity of this document is confirmed before me. It was written by
  2. Ḥasan ibn ʾIbrāhīm ibn Rizq in his (own) handwriting.
  3. In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful
  4. This is what Bandalūs ibn Buṭrus the tailor has bought from Baqām ibn Kayl ibn Qūrīl. They are both [numbered] among the inhabitants of the village known as that Ṭuṭūn in the district of
  5. Fayyūm. He bought from him the living room known as the living room of ʾAbū Thaydar to its limit and its boundaries, with its upper part and lower part, and its timber [and its doors] and its stones and it is known and witnessed by
  6. Kayl ibn Qūrīl. It is very well-known so there is no need to describe its boundaries. [The sale also includes] the passageway that [starts] from the door of this large house and goes up to this living room. And the storehouse that is
  7. under this living room. And what is enclosed by its four boundaries and every right that is within and out of it as well as its doors, its timbers, and its stones. The door of the storehouse opens to the [courtyard] of the large house
  8. known as the house of Kayl ibn Qūrīl. He bought all of this living room and its passageway and its storehouse and the passageway belonging to the storehouse for (a sum of) money which amounts in Muʿizzī gold coins of full weight
  9. to nine dīnārs, half of which is four and a half dīnārs in gold minted coins of good alloy. Baqām ibn Kayl ibn Qūrīl received from Bandalūs
  10. ibn Buṭrus, the tailor, this price completely and in full and released him from this a release of full receipt and delivered to him the abovementioned property,
  11. described in this document. He (i.e., Bandalus) owned it and acquired it and it passed into his possession and into his holding as his property. If he wishes he may sell, if he wishes he may give it away as gift, and if he wishes he may endow it.
  12. [This is] a valid sale without any condition, any option [to annul it], any restriction or reserve. Should there be any claim made against Bandalūs ibn Buṭrus in this sale
  13. by way of claims by a third party, or attachments, or litigation, or if someone should suddenly appear with a debt, or should make a claim on the basis on an inheritance, its clearing and its execution (recuperation) is obligatory upon Baqām ibn Kayl from his own
  14. money whatever it may be and whatever it may amount to. This happened after everything that is in this document was read to them letter by letter and they acknowledged
  15. understanding and cognition of it while being in sound mind and body, legally capable of conducting their affairs, acting voluntarily, not forced or coerced. And this document was written
  16. in the month of Ṣafar of the year four hundred and thirty.

body.label: Witness clauses
body.value:
1. شهد المكنا بأبي العلا بن حديج التطوني بجميع ما فيه وكت ب عنه جابر بن ياسين بامره ومحضره
  2. شهد محمد بن ياسين بجميع ما فيه وكتب عنه جابر بن ياسين بامره و محضره
  3. شهد جابر بن ياسين علي إقرار البايع بالبيع وقب ض الثمن وعلي المشتري بالشرا و الاحازه و كتب بخطه في تأريخه و الحمد لله حق حمده
  4. شهد عليان بن ابراهيم بجميع ما في هذا الكتاب و كتب بخطه
  5. و ان حصه حنّة ابنت كيل بن قوريل التطوني باقيه لها في المجلس المعروف بابو ثيدر
  6. من المنتهي الشرقي و من الدار المعروف بدار قوريل بن كيل و بذلك اشهدوا علي أنفسهم ثيدر و دنيل ولدي
  7. بندلوس الخياط و كتب الحسن بن ابراهيم بن رزق بخطه في تأريخه
  8. شهد عليان ابراهيم بجميع ما في هذا الكتاب و كتب بخطه في تأريخه

body.label: Witness clauses
body.value:
1. The [person] bearing the patronymic ʾAbī al-‘Alā ibn Ḥudayj al-Ṭuṭūnī testified to all of what is herein. This has been written by Jābir ibn Yāsin on his behalf by his instruction and in his presence.
  2. Muḥammad ibn Yāsin testified to all of what is herein. This has been written by Jābir ibn Yāsin on his behalf by his instruction and in his presence.
  3. Jābir ibn Yāsin testified to the acknowledgement by the sellers of the sale and receipt of the price and [the acknowledgement] by the buyer of the sale and acquirement [of the property. He wrote this in his (own) handwriting on its date. All praise is due to God as it is worthy of his right.
  4. ʿAlyān ibn ʾIbrāhīm testified to all that is contained in this document and wrote in his (own) handwriting.
  5. The share of Ḥannat, the daughter of Kayl ibn Qūrīl al-Ṭuṭūnī, remains for her in the living room known as ʾAbū Thaydar
  6. 6. in its utmost eastern side and (also her share) of the house known as the house of Qūrīl ibn Kayl. Witnesses were called regarding this by Thaydar and Rabābīl, the children of
  7. Bandalūs the tailor. Ḥasan ibn ʾIbrāhīm ibn Rizq wrote this in his (own) handwriting on its date.
  8. ʿAlyān ibn ʾIbrāhīm testified to all that is contained in this document and wrote in his (own) handwriting.
